h1: The complete MCP runtime for coding, decisions, browser, and cloud

p: Give any model a filesystem, shell, semantic AST code index, Kai sub-10ms decisions, Playwright & Chrome DevTools browser control, issue tracking, persistent memory, and 1,700+ typed Hanzo Cloud operations over stdio or streamable HTTP.
Open source, MIT. Identical tool names and schemas in TypeScript, Python, and Rust — plus remote streamable HTTP at api.hanzo.ai/v1/mcp.

Core runtime (fs, exec, code, git, fetch, workspace, ui), semantic code intelligence (code_search, code_context, code_ask, code_index), Kai decision & safety guardrails (kai_decide, kai_command_guard, kai_injection_screen), browser CDP, issue tracker, and persistent memory.

Through the unified hanzo router and /docs/mcp-tools catalog, agents provision sandboxes, deploy containers across 34 regions, query vector indexes, rotate KMS secrets, verify IAM policies, and inspect billing usage under one bearer key.

Every shell command and external input can pass through kai_command_guard and kai_injection_screen in single-digit milliseconds. Enable or drop tool groups per environment with --enable-tools and --disable-tools.

p: Tool domains

h2: Every surface an autonomous team needs

p: From local AST refactoring and headless browser verification to multi-region cloud deployments.
read, write, stat, list, mkdir, rm, mv, apply_patch, search_text — plus exec with run, background, ps, kill, and logs so long-running dev servers and test suites stream cleanly.
AST-aware symbol resolution, call graphs, cross-repository indexing, and structural transforms. Find every caller of a symbol in 2ms without grep noise.
13 purpose-built Kai decision, scoring, routing, log triage, recovery, and context compaction tools running in 6.4ms at a fraction of LLM token cost.
Full Playwright and Chrome DevTools Protocol automation (navigate, click, screenshot, console, network), complete git workflows, and streaming HTTP fetch.
tracker_boards, tracker_issues, tracker_create, and tracker_update sync directly with engineering boards, while memory, think, and plan persist architecture context across sessions.
Direct typed access to Deploy, Sandbox, IAM, KMS, KV, S3, Vector, Search, Crawl, Workflow, Commerce, and Billing — inspectable at docs.hanzo.ai/docs/mcp-tools.
Get started
Use the --package= form for local stdio, or point any MCP client directly at https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/mcp over streamable HTTP.

code: // .mcp.json — add Hanzo MCP to any MCP client { " mcpServers " : { " hanzo " : { " command " : " npx " , " args " : [ " -y " , " hanzo " , " mcp " ] } } } // Or install the whole native stack once and run it yourself: //   npm i -g hanzo //   hanzo mcp              # stdio; the binary downloads on first run //   hanzo mcp -t sse       # or over HTTP
